q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a precast concrete pole?
title: Concrete pole carbon footprint per pole
short: A prestressed concrete pole is cement, aggregate and high tensile wire. Multiply each by its supplier figure per pole, then add mixing, casting and curing energy divided by poles cast. Report by length.
audience: PSC pole makers for power distribution

ul: Cement, sand and coarse aggregate by weight.
High tensile steel wire for prestressing.
Stressing the wire and casting in moulds.
Steam or water curing and handling.

p: Report per pole by length and load class, the way utility tenders specify them.

example.title: Worked example: precast concrete pole unit per pole (one month)
lines: Plant total: 16,010 / 3,000 = 5.337 kg CO2 per pole
Add cement and steel wire for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
